description: March 24 birthday meaning: Aries decan 1, birthday number 6, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a March 24 birthday falls in Aries, in the first decan, with Mars as the sign's ruler and Mars as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 6. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Aries is cardinal and fire.

sections.heading: March 24 zodiac sign and personality
paragraphs: Even fire signs have caretakers. On March 24 the 24 reduces to 6, numerology's protective number, while the Sun stands about three degrees into Aries under Mars's double rule. The reading is a champion of the people close to them: someone who defends friends loudly and shows care by taking action, not by talking.

On March 24 the Sun usually sits at about 3° Aries, in the first decan, where Mars rules the decan as well as the sign. The opening stretch of Aries, from 0 to 9 degrees, is often called the purest expression of the sign, because Mars governs Aries and also acts as sub-ruler here. Astrologers traditionally picture this decan as the spark at the very start of the zodiac: quick to move, frank in speech and happiest with something to push against. The doubled Mars emphasis tends to sharpen courage and an appetite for challenge, and it can also shorten patience with slow processes. Many of these Rams recognise the urge to start before the plan is finished. Their growing edge is usually learning that a pause is not the same as a defeat.

sections.heading: March 24 in numerology
paragraphs: A birthday on the 24th reduces as 2 + 4 = 6. The compound combines the 2's emotional attentiveness and the 4's reliability, feeding into the 6's devotion to home and community. Those born on this day are often described as dependable carers: the one who brings soup, fixes the shelf and remembers what you said last month. Stability in family life tends to matter a great deal to them. As a secondary number, the 24 points towards a gift for creating safe, well-run spaces. Accepting help in return is often their quiet area of growth.

The Life Path, the main number in a numerology chart, also uses the birth year, so it changes from one March 24 birthday to the next: it is 7 for 1960, 8 for 1970, 9 for 1980 and 1 for 1990, for example. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11.

sections.heading: Born on March 24: season, famous birthdays and Chinese zodiac
paragraphs: A March birthday falls around the spring equinox for the northern hemisphere, the season of thaw and first growth, while southern birthdays mark the turn into autumn. The month is split between Pisces and Aries, with the change around March 20 or 21. In numerology March is month 3, linked with expression, creativity and sociability, a lively number for a month that ends with the zodiac starting over. March 24 is the 83rd day of the year (84th in a leap year). By April 20, 27 days later, the Sun has usually moved on into Taurus.

For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by March 24, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year. Well-known people born on March 24 include Dario Fo (1926), Harry Houdini (1874) and Nathalia Dill (1986).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is March 24?
faq.answer: March 24 is Aries in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Aries, which tradition links with Mars.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on March 24?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On March 24 the Life Path is 7 in 1960, 8 in 1970, 9 in 1980, 1 in 1990, 11 in 2000, 3 in 2010 and 4 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 6 for everyone born on the 24th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on March 24?
faq.answer: Chinese astrology is straightforward for a March 24 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on March 24?
faq.answer: March 24 is also the birthday of Dario Fo (1926), Harry Houdini (1874) and Nathalia Dill (1986). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
